pain_points.description: List of assessed pain points from the framework

number.description: Pain point number from the framework (1-20)

pain_point.description: The pain point statement from the framework

observed.description: Whether the pain point was observed in the transcript

score_status.description: N/A if not observed, Medium if observed, High if observed and causes disruption

verbatim_quotes.description: Exact quotes from transcript supporting this pain point. Empty array if not observed.
